name: Mikaeus
description: Lunarch killed by Geralf and raised as a zombie by Liliana.

description_citations.text: "Thraben". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dovid solves the Nightfall Cathars' spell on the journal and learns that Avacyn had been sealed with Griselbrand and that church power diminished, a secret kept from the congregation.
timeline.quote: Avacyn had been sealed in the Helvault with the demon Griselbrand, and during that time our power had diminished.

citation.text: "The Lunarch's Journal" by Colin Kawakami. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Geralf says Liliana took Mikaeus's body in Thraben and left.
timeline.quote: She took Mikaeus's body back in Thraben and absconded.

citation.text: "Games" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Griselbrand challenges Avacyn at the Helvault; she drives him in but he impales her and she is imprisoned too.
timeline.quote: Avacyn became imprisoned in the Helvault alongside every other demon that had been trapped within

citation.text: "Avacyn", section "Disappearance of Balance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn has not been seen for several seasons and darkness advances.
timeline.quote: However, the Archangel Avacyn had not been seen in several seasons

citation.text: "Church of Avacyn", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lunarch Mikaeus dies in the Siege of Thraben and his successor Macher is killed early in Avacyn's madness.
timeline.quote: After Lunarch Mikaeus died during the Siege of Thraben , and his successor Macher was killed in the early days of Avacyn's madness

citation.text: "Church of Avacyn", section "Lunarch Council". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Geralf sets up the siege of Thraben, sneaks in to kill Mikaeus, and meets Liliana who brings Mikaeus back as a zombie.
timeline.quote: Geralf snuck into the city before the attack to kill Mikaeus .

citation.text: "Geralf Cecani", section "NecroWarfare". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Geralf starts the siege of Thraben and invites Gisa along, ending their engagement; he sneaks into the city to kill Mikaeus.
timeline.quote: Geralf snuck into the city before the attack to kill Mikaeus .

citation.text: "Gisa Cecani", section "NecroWarfare". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana brings Mikaeus back as a zombie.
timeline.quote: Later he met up with Liliana , who shortly thereafter brought Mikaeus back as a zombie .

citation.text: "Gisa Cecani", section "NecroWarfare". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After days of battle Avacyn drove Griselbrand into the Helvault; he impaled her heart with his spear and she was drawn in too.
timeline.quote: Avacyn was drawn into the Helvault herself.

citation.text: "Helvault", section "The Helvault imprisonment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn's imprisonment caused a crisis of faith across Innistrad.
timeline.quote: leading to a crisis of faith across all four provinces

citation.text: "Helvault", section "The waning of the light". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Griselbrand fights Avacyn for days; she drives him into the Helvault but is impaled by his spear and trapped inside alongside the demons.
timeline.quote: Avacyn became imprisoned in the Helvault alongside every other demon that had been trapped within

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "Disappearance of balance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mikaeus witnesses the duel of Avacyn and Griselbrand and their imprisonment, swearing the witnesses to secrecy.
timeline.quote: those present (including the Lunarch himself) chose to swear themselves to secrecy

citation.text: "Mikaeus Cecani", section "Imprisonment of Avacyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mikaeus spends his days reassuring the populace that Avacyn is still among them, which is a lie.
timeline.quote: Mikaeus would spend his days reassuring the populace that all is well

citation.text: "Mikaeus Cecani", section "Imprisonment of Avacyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Geralf and Gisa besiege Thraben; Mikaeus appoints Thalia supreme commander after Luthor is found dead.
timeline.quote: he appointed Thalia as the supreme commander of the city's forces

citation.text: "Mikaeus Cecani", section "The Undead Siege". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Geralf sneaks behind the defenses and stabs Mikaeus with a letter opener, carving out his heart.
timeline.quote: Geralf assaulted him with a letter opener, fatally stabbing the Lunarch

citation.text: "Mikaeus Cecani", section "The Undead Siege". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bishop Alwin decrees Mikaeus be interred secretly to protect faith.
timeline.quote: decreed that Mikaeus would be interred into the tomb of the Lunarchs unceremoniously

citation.text: "Mikaeus Cecani", section "The Unhallowed". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana raises Mikaeus as a zombie, forces him to reveal the Helvault's secrets, then goes to perform the Sundering.
timeline.quote: Liliana raised Mikaeus as a zombie

citation.text: "Mikaeus Cecani", section "The Unhallowed". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana raises Mikaeus Cecani's corpse and learns Griselbrand is trapped in the Helvault.
timeline.quote: learning from him that Griselbrand was trapped in the Helvault

citation.text: "Sundering of the Helvault", section "Sundering". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Avacyn's absence, Gisa and Geralf besiege Thraben; Geralf kills Lunarch Mikaeus and Liliana raises him as a zombie.
timeline.quote: Geralf snuck into the city before the attack to kill Lunarch Mikaeus .

citation.text: "Thraben", section "Siege of Thraben". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Macher knew Mikaeus, the former lunarch, and saw him as a zombie.
relations.quote: Macher had known Mikaeus, the former lunarch

citation.text: "A Gaze Blank and Pitiless" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Mar 2016.

relations.note: She took his body in Thraben.
relations.quote: She took Mikaeus's body back in Thraben and absconded.

citation.text: "Games" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2016.

relations.quote: Geralf snuck into the city before the attack to kill Mikaeus .

citation.text: "Geralf Cecani", section "NecroWarfare". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: Geralf assaulted him with a letter opener, fatally stabbing the Lunarch

citation.text: "Mikaeus Cecani", section "The Undead Siege". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: raised him as a zombie to use against the Helvault
relations.quote: Liliana raised Mikaeus as a zombie to destroy all that he fought so hard to protect in life

citation.text: "Mikaeus Cecani", section "The Unhallowed". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: killed by his cousin Geralf Cecani

citation.text: "Sundering of the Helvault", section "Sundering". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Killed him before Liliana raised him as a zombie.
